subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded runner "Network connection lost" when LLM generates a tool call with large parameters (param generation latency > underlying request timeout)

question: Should OpenClaw handle this as an OpenRouter/Anthropic streaming-compatibility fix, a timeout/error-handling policy fix, or documentation around the existing provider timeout setting?
rationale: The code has a configurable timeout mitigation and a separate direct-Anthropic streaming path, but choosing a default behavior for OpenRouter affects provider compatibility and user-visible hang duration.

options.title: Live repro then provider-owned fix
options.body: Require a current-main OpenRouter repro and implement the narrowest supported provider/runtime fix, preferring streaming compatibility when OpenRouter exposes the needed contract.

options.title: Document existing timeout setting
options.body: Keep runtime defaults unchanged and document `models.providers.openrouter.timeoutSeconds` as the supported workaround for slow OpenRouter tool-call generation.

options.title: Add or change timeout policy
options.body: Change the default or add a new knob only if maintainers intentionally accept the broader compatibility and hang-duration tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Live repro then provider-owned fix
recommendation.body: Require a current-main OpenRouter repro and implement the narrowest supported provider/runtime fix, preferring streaming compatibility when OpenRouter exposes the needed contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent stream cleanup/watchdog locality and provider fallback work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the provider/runtime policy decision.
